criteria.criterion: ReaderInputs in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs gains an optional earlier-attempt field (job id, request text, findings). reader_brief renders it as its own quoted section only when present; output without it is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: the new EarlierAttempt struct has fields job, request and findings, and ReaderInputs gains earlier_attempt: Option<EarlierAttempt>. reader_brief writes the '# Earlier attempt' section, with quote() around the request and each finding, only inside `if let Some(attempt)`. With None, every other part of the brief is built exactly as before.

criteria.criterion: A function in athena-core detects 'try again on <job>', resolves the job, and builds the attempt from that job's request record and final verification findings. It refuses a job that is not rejected, or that lacks a request or verification, with an error naming the job and its state.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: the new pub fn earlier_attempt in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs matches the prefix case-insensitively with eq_ignore_ascii_case and resolves the job with records.resolve. If the state is not Closed(Rejected) it bails with 'job {id} is {state}; only a rejected job can be tried again'. It also bails, naming the job and state, when the job has no request record or no verification record. It builds the attempt from job.request.text and from job.verification findings and reasons.

criteria.criterion: read_for and first_reading in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs pass the attempt to reader_brief, and the carried text goes through the redactor.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: read_for takes a new attempt: Option<&EarlierAttempt> parameter and passes it to ReaderInputs as earlier_attempt. first_reading, the re-read for corrections and run.rs reread_after_configuration_change all compute the attempt with earlier_attempt(..., &redactor). Inside earlier_attempt, redactor.redact_all(&mut texts) runs on the request text and every finding before they are returned.

criteria.criterion: README.md and CHANGELOG.md mention the 'try again on <job>' form.
criteria.evidence: From reading the diff: README.md gains a paragraph on `athena ask "try again on <job>"`, and CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] gains an Added entry describing the form.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a unit test in briefs.rs shows the brief contains the earlier request and findings when set and lacks the section when unset.
criteria.evidence: I ran it: reader_briefs_carry_an_earlier_attempt_only_when_set passed. It asserts the section is absent when unset, and that the quoted request and finding are present when set. reader_briefs_carry_corrections_and_the_reference also passed and asserts there is no 'Earlier attempt' section.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a lifecycle test with the fake driver rejects a job, then asks 'try again on <id>' and shows the reader brief includes that job's request and findings. Another test shows a landed or unknown job is refused.
criteria.evidence: I ran both tests and both passed. try_again_on_a_rejected_job_carries_its_request_and_findings_to_the_reader uses a failing verdict, records each reader brief, asks 'Try again on <id>, please', and checks the brief has ORIGINAL-CANARY, FINDING-CANARY and the new request as typed. try_again_on_a_landed_or_unknown_job_is_refused checks that the error names the job and 'landed', that an unknown id is refused, and that HEAD does not change.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`: both are clean.
criteria.evidence: I ran both. fmt printed nothing (clean). Clippy finished with -D warnings and reported no warnings. Athena's own checks also passed on this tree.

findings.summary: Several refusal branches have no test of their own: an in-flight job, a job missing its request or verification record, and 'try again on' with no job id.
findings.evidence: The refusal test covers only a landed job and an unknown id. The reading's assumptions also name in-flight jobs as refused, and that path is checked only by the general state test in the code.

findings.summary: Two files differ from the expected deliverables, for good reasons.
findings.evidence: The lifecycle tests are in crates/athena-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs because crates/athena-core/tests does not exist (shown by ls). crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs was not modified because earlier_attempt is public in the reading module. run.rs was also changed, which was needed so that re-reads after a configuration change carry the attempt too.

summary: The change does what was asked. If a request starts with "try again on <job>" (any letter case), Athena now finds that job. If the job was rejected, the reader's brief gets a new "Earlier attempt" section quoting the job's request and its final verification's findings and reasons. That text passes through the redactor first. The new job's own request stays as typed. Landed, unknown, in-flight and malformed retries are refused with an error naming the job and its state. README and CHANGELOG describe the new form. I ran the new unit and lifecycle tests, `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, and all were clean. I found no blocker or major issue. Two things differ from the expected deliverables: the lifecycle tests are in crates/athena-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs because crates/athena-core/tests does not exist, and lib.rs was not needed because the function is public in reading.rs. Some refusal branches, such as an in-flight job, have no test of their own.
